fact: We Are Tech Africa reports that Morocco's 'Digital X.0' framework bill, on AI, data governance, digital identity and interoperability, was under review by the General Secretariat of the Government, and that it sets an interoperability model in which any exchange of information between public agencies is authorised by the user through traceable consent (a draft bill, not in force); no event date is given, so the article's published date is used.

EuroMedAI says a draft framework law known as Digital X.0, covering data governance, digital identity and interoperability, was reported in late 2025 to be under review at the General Secretariat of the Government.
